title: Bella vita militar
subtitle: Chorus of soldiers: chorus from Così fan tutte, Act 1 (No. 8)

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 1 scene 5, No. 8 Coro
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score. The print gives no words under the basses.

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 52–54, bars 1–51 of No. 8
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (one error found in bar 43 and corrected). The German singing translation is left out. Bar 1 is the one-beat upbeat, set as 1/4. The sopranos and altos share one staff in the print and are written as two parts; where one notehead has two stems, both sing it. Playback tempo: Maestoso, played at a half note = 67 (♩ = 134), about 1½ minutes, the median of six recordings (Böhm, Haitink, Solti, Nézet-Séguin, Currentzis, Marriner); Mozart gives the word only.
